page_title: ROM 0-1 INT | AS Roma v Inter 20/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.

90+4' A neat pass is well received by Matias Soule (AS Roma), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
90+2' AS Roma produce a short pass from the free kick.

90+1' Davide Massa blows his whistle after Nicolo Barella (Inter) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. It's a free kick to AS Roma, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

90+1' Nicolo Barella (Inter) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) sends a chip pass into the box, but Yann Sommer is quickest to intercept the ball.

87' Matias Soule (AS Roma) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
86' Joaquin Correa (Inter) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Mile Svilar comes off his line to intercept.
85' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Mile Svilar.
83' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Davide Massa who sees an offensive foul.
79' Ivan Juric has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mario Hermoso replacing Angelino (AS Roma).
79' Here comes a substitution. Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is given a rest as he is replaced by Enzo Le Fee.
78' Joaquin Correa (Inter) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
78' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) comes off the pitch to be replaced by Matias Soule.
78' Marcus Thuram (Inter) dribbles into the box, but Mile Svilar is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
77' The corner by Federico Dimarco (Inter) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

76' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Mile Svilar makes a save. The ball goes out for a corner. Inter can continue in their attacking effort.
72' Substitution. Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) did his best and is replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi.
72' Substitution. Lautaro Martinez (Inter) walks off the pitch and Joaquin Correa comes on as a substitute.
71' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Matteo Darmian (Inter) is replaced by Denzel Dumfries.
71' That's the end of the game for Alessandro Bastoni, who is replaced by Yann Bisseck (Inter).
70' A dangerous towering header by Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
70' The ball goes behind for a corner. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. AS Roma win a corner.
68' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Matteo Darmian (Inter) for his blatant foul.
65' Federico Dimarco (Inter) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
65' Marcus Thuram (Inter) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Inter.
62' What was Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
60' 0 - 1 Goal! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes past the goalkeeper. It's 0:1.
59' AS Roma fail to score from a corner as Yann Sommer (Inter) leaps to collect the ball.
59' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. AS Roma will have a chance to score from a corner.
58' Marcus Thuram (Inter) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
53' Ivan Juric decides to make a substitution. Manu Kone (AS Roma) will be replaced by Niccolo Pisilli.
51' Nicolo Barella (Inter) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) was quite harsh and Davide Massa didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' Nicolo Barella (Inter) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
46' The whistle blows and Davide Massa starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) wins the aerial battle and plants a header at goal from near the penalty after a good cross from Evan Ndicka. It's a fine attempt but sails narrowly wide of the left post.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

45' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Davide Massa with no other option than to blow for a foul.
43' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
42' It doesn’t look good for Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!

41' A sweet pass finds Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Yann Sommer is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
39' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mile Svilar, who smothers the ball.
35' Simone Inzaghi (Inter) uses bad language while talking to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
34' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) commits a foul and Davide Massa immediately signals a free kick.
34' Inter players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
27' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Stefan de Vrij.
26' The injury to Francesco Acerbi (Inter) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
25' Paulo Dybala floats in a cross for Evan Ndicka (AS Roma), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and floats high over the bar.
23' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the corner with a short pass.
19' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header low towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
15' Angelino (AS Roma) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
15' AS Roma decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
15' Nicolo Barella (Inter) commits a rough foul. Davide Massa stops the game and makes a call. A free kick is awarded to AS Roma.
13' Crossbar! Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
12' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is being substituted because of an injury. Simone Inzaghi sends Davide Frattesi on the pitch.
11' Great touch by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
10' Davide Massa interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Evan Ndicka (AS Roma).
9' A pass from Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is intercepted by Mile Svilar and the move breaks down.
7' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
7' Federico Dimarco (Inter) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

6' That was a nice football moment. Marcus Thuram (Inter) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Mile Svilar guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
4' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
3' Marcus Thuram (Inter) is penalised for a foul. Davide Massa had a clear view and blows his whistle.
2' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
